description: Happy New Year to all! With the start of 2026, the newsletter is back. I held another Saturday morning coffee on January 24th at the Raley’s Markey on Wedge Parkway, in their community room. There was a great turnout and we had good discussions for over an hour. My next coffee will be in late February at 9:00am at the same location. I will be sending a separate text announcement closer to the date. Hope to see you there. I looking forward to talking with more of you as we move into the 2026 camp
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY DELONG FOR NEVADA DeLong For Nevada
title: DeLong For Nevada Newsletter February 2026
